# Factor42 Media

> Factor42 Media is a white-label ad operations and campaign fulfillment company. Agencies and TV and radio broadcast groups sell digital campaigns to their clients; Factor42 traffics, QAs, optimizes and reports on those campaigns under the partner's brand.

- Channels: Google Ads (Search, Display, Performance Max, Shopping), YouTube, Meta, Instagram, TikTok, LinkedIn, Reddit, X, Pinterest, Snapchat, programmatic display, video and audio (DV360, The Trade Desk, Xandr, Amazon DSP), streaming TV (OTT/CTV), digital out-of-home (DOOH) and email marketing.
- Results: 98.6% campaign delivery rate; 100+ agency and media partners; 12-minute average trafficking turnaround; Google Ads campaigns launch in under 4 hours on average.
- Who it serves: marketing agencies (white-label ad ops, PPC and paid social) and TV/radio broadcast groups (digital fulfillment for station sellers, market-level reporting).
- Company: Factor42 Media Inc., 8 The Green, Ste E, Dover, DE 19901, United States. Contact: https://factor42media.com/contact

## Pages

- [Home](https://factor42media.com/): Overview, services, process and every channel Factor42 runs
- [For agencies](https://factor42media.com/agencies): White-label ad ops, PPC and paid social for agencies; economics and FAQ
- [For broadcasters](https://factor42media.com/broadcasters): Digital menu for TV and radio sellers, order-to-delivery workflow, market reporting, switchover
- [About](https://factor42media.com/about): Company and working principles
- [Service level agreements](https://factor42media.com/sla): What Factor42 SLAs cover: turnaround, QA, pacing, reporting, escalation
- [Security & confidentiality](https://factor42media.com/security): Account access, confidentiality and data handling
- [Book a consultation](https://factor42media.com/contact): Request a fulfillment plan and wholesale rate card
- [Blog](https://factor42media.com/blog/): 105 guides on advertising channels, budgets and choosing a marketing partner
